disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了密钥读取方式：代码经 dsh 的凭据服务解析 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY（宿主标准凭据接口），未发现直接读取磁盘上凭据文件、硬编码密钥或把密钥写入日志的路径。
checked_items.en: Checked the credential reading method: the code resolves DEEPSEEK_API_KEY via dsh's credential service (host standard credential interface). No path directly reading credential files on disk, hardcoding keys, or writing keys to logs was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了密钥流向：密钥仅作为请求头随余额查询发往 DeepSeek 官方余额接口，无其他外发目标；README 第 98 行只是向用户说明凭据存放位置，不构成代码读取行为。
checked_items.en: Checked the credential flow: the key is only sent as a request header to DeepSeek's official balance endpoint for balance queries; no other outbound destinations. README line 98 merely explains to users where credentials are stored and does not constitute code-level reading behavior.

checked_items.zh: 未发现钱包、云凭据或私钥枚举类行为。
checked_items.en: No wallet, cloud credential, or private key enumeration behavior found.

evidence.zh: 未检出恶意凭据外泄：密钥经 dsh 凭据服务读取后仅发往 DeepSeek 官方余额接口用于余额查询（插件核心业务），README 中提及凭据文件位置仅为文档说明，代码无直接读取该文件的路径。
evidence.en: No malicious credential exfiltration detected: after being read via the dsh credential service, the key is only sent to DeepSeek's official balance endpoint for balance queries (the plugin's core business). The mention of the credential file location in the README is documentation only; the code has no path that directly reads that file.

checked_items.zh: 检查了模型可读文本面：插件未注册任何工具，也没有向系统提示注入内容的面，因此不存在工具描述或提示词段落可被投毒。
checked_items.en: Checked the model-readable text surface: the plugin registers no tools and has no surface for injecting content into the system prompt, so there is no tool description or prompt segment that could be poisoned.

checked_items.zh: 检查了仓库中的指令类文件（AGENTS、SKILL、CLAUDE 等）与 README、文档、注释中的指令覆写、伪装系统消息、诱导安装等措辞，未发现命中。
checked_items.en: Checked instruction-type files in the repository (AGENTS, SKILL, CLAUDE, etc.) and README, documentation, and comments for instruction overrides, disguised system messages, or wording that induces installation; no hits found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了模型输入改写接缝与历史压缩实现，插件均未挂接。
checked_items.en: Checked the model-input rewriting seams and history compression implementations; the plugin hooks none of them.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具，无工具描述进入模型请求的面，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools, so there is no surface where tool descriptions enter model requests. The scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 无工具描述面，README 与源码未见诱导安装或诱导改写配置的措辞。
evidence.en: No tool description surface exists; the README and source code show no wording that induces installation or rewriting of configuration.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听模型输入守门事件，无改写或注入消息的面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to model-input gating events and has no surface for rewriting or injecting messages.

checked_items.zh: 检查了危险执行面：源码中未发现动态执行、子进程调用、下载即执行或解码即执行模式。
checked_items.en: Checked the dangerous execution surface: no dynamic execution, subprocess invocation, download-and-execute, or decode-and-execute patterns were found in the source code.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装钩子与树内执行载体：包脚本只有测试、构建与打包校验，无安装期钩子；仓库无工作流、钩子管理器、容器配置、Makefile、子模块等可执行载体。
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks and in-tree execution carriers: package scripts only cover test, build, and package verification, with no install-time hook; the repository has no workflows, hook managers, container configurations, Makefile, submodules, or other executable carriers.

checked_items.zh: 检查了两个挂载补丁：内容仅为插入插件条目，无 JS 求值标量，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置。
checked_items.en: Checked the two patches: the content only inserts plugin entries, contains no JS-evaluable scalars, and does not touch security configurations such as sandbox, approval, or permissions.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端 bundle：只调用本机接口与本地存储，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取或凭据写入类调用；声明的客户端 bundle 为 UI 组件。
checked_items.en: Checked the browser-side bundle: it only calls local interfaces and local storage; no keyboard listening, clipboard reading, or credential-writing calls were found. The declared client bundle is a UI component.

evidence.zh: 两个挂载补丁均无 JS 求值标量，只做普通配置插入，不存在经补丁执行任意代码的面。
evidence.en: Both patches contain no JS-evaluable scalars; they only perform ordinary configuration insertion, so there is no surface for arbitrary code execution via patches.

evidence.zh: 未调用动态代码包工具，无让模型代码在宿主执行的面。
evidence.en: No dynamic code package tools are invoked, and there is no surface for model code to execute on the host.

evidence.zh: 包无安装期钩子，仓库无其他可执行载体；README 安装指引未锁 commit 属宿主侧安装习惯，本插件无安装期执行面。
evidence.en: The package has no install-time hook, and the repository has no other executable carriers. The README installation instructions do not pin commits, which is a host-side installation habit; this plugin has no install-time execution surface.

evidence.zh: 声明了客户端 bundle，已做专项检查：bundle 仅请求本机 API 与读写本地存储，未发现键盘、剪贴板、凭据 RPC 等危险行为。
evidence.en: A client bundle is declared and has been specifically checked: the bundle only requests local APIs and reads/writes local storage; no dangerous behaviors such as keyboard, clipboard, or credential RPC were found.

evidence.zh: 未注册外部子代理提供方，无把轮次委派给进程外产品的面。
evidence.en: No external subagent provider is registered, and there is no surface for delegating turns to out-of-process products.

evidence.zh: 未注册后台任务、定时任务或持久目标，无 dsh 原生持驻面。
evidence.en: No background tasks, scheduled tasks, or persistent targets are registered, and there is no dsh-native persistent surface.

checked_items.zh: 梳理了全部外联目标：代码唯一的网络请求是向 DeepSeek 官方余额接口查询余额；README 中的外链均为徽章图片与社区、赞助商链接，不参与运行。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all outbound targets: the only network request in the code queries the balance from DeepSeek's official balance endpoint. External links in the README are badge images and community/sponsor links and do not participate in runtime behavior.

checked_items.zh: 检查了数据流出链：本地写入的用量明细只落在本机数据目录，未见编码变换后外发、隧道、带外通道或端点劫持。
checked_items.en: Checked the data outflow chain: locally written usage details stay only in the local data directory; no encoded transformation exfiltration, tunneling, out-of-band channels, or endpoint hijacking was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了模型路由接缝：未监听模型请求路由事件，未注册自定义模型适配器，无把对话重路由到其他端点的面。
checked_items.en: Checked the model routing seams: no model request routing events are listened to, no custom model adapter is registered, and there is no surface for rerouting conversation to other endpoints.

evidence.zh: 唯一外联为 DeepSeek 官方余额接口（余额查询业务），无凭据外发或其他数据流出通道。
evidence.en: The only outbound connection is DeepSeek's official balance endpoint (for balance query business); no credential exfiltration or other data outflow channels exist.

evidence.zh: 未监听模型请求路由及错误恢复事件，未注册自定义模型适配器，场景不适用。
evidence.en: No model request routing or error recovery events are listened to, and no custom model adapter is registered. The scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖清单：全部为 DeepSeek 官方 @deepseek-ai 包及通用开源包（react、zod 等），未发现抢注或易混淆依赖。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency manifest: all dependencies are official @deepseek-ai packages from DeepSeek and common open-source packages (react, zod, etc.); no typosquatted or confusingly similar dependencies were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载补丁对安全配置的影响：补丁未改写沙箱、审批、权限等安全行，未使用环境变量降权，未改写依赖注入配置。
checked_items.en: Checked the impact of the patches on security configurations: the patches do not rewrite security lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, do not use environment variables to lower privileges, and do not modify dependency injection configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装期行为：无安装钩子、无远程脚本执行；首次审计无版本基线，无法做升级对比。
checked_items.en: Checked install-time behavior: no install hooks or remote script execution. As this is the first audit, there is no version baseline for upgrade comparison.

evidence.zh: 补丁未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，无禁用项或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patches do not touch security configurations such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and contain no disabled features or environment-variable privilege-lowering patterns.

evidence.zh: 未对审批等安全事件注册优先监听，无截断审批链的面。
evidence.en: No priority listener is registered for security events such as approval, and there is no surface for truncating the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首版审计无基线版本可比较，升级自动激活场景不适用。
evidence.en: As this is the first audit, there is no baseline version to compare; the upgrade-auto-activation scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 补丁未改写依赖注入或拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其挂起的面。
evidence.en: The patches do not modify dependency injection or interception configurations, so there is no surface for appending mandatory services to security plugins and causing them to hang.

checked_items.zh: 检查了运行时行为：插件经宿主网页服务注册了余额、用量、扣费事件与图片四个只读本地端点；本机无认证可达属 dsh 生态固有模型（无认证、仅可达性围栏），非本插件引入的独立风险，按场景定义标注于此。
checked_items.en: Checked runtime behavior: the plugin registers four read-only local endpoints (balance, usage, charge events, and image) via the host web service. Local unauthenticated reachability is an inherent model of the dsh ecosystem (no authentication, reachability-fencing only), not an independent risk introduced by this plugin; it is annotated here per scenario definition.

checked_items.zh: 检查了本地持久化：用量明细仅追加写入本机 dsh 数据目录，无跨进程或远程侧信道。
checked_items.en: Checked local persistence: usage details are appended only to the local dsh data directory; no cross-process or remote side channels were found.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱未执行（本环境未提供动态验证产物），运行时行为以静态分析为准。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox was not executed (this environment did not provide dynamic verification artifacts); runtime behavior is based on static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动监听服务，仅消费宿主网页服务注册只读端点；本机无认证可达属 dsh 生态固有模型，已在检测痕迹中标注，非本插件引入的独立风险。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a listening service itself; it only consumes the host web service to register read-only endpoints. Local unauthenticated reachability is an inherent model of the dsh ecosystem and is annotated in the detection traces; it is not an independent risk introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：dsh 声明齐全，未发现名称仿冒或异常作者信息。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: dsh declarations are complete, and no name impersonation or anomalous author information was found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描未检出恶意代码面；4 条机械预扫命中（DG-R3-60 三条、DG-R1-51 一条）经逐条核查均为构建、文档产物或文档化引用，排除。
summary.en: Static scanning detected no malicious code surface. The 4 mechanical pre-scan hits (three for DG-R3-60, one for DG-R1-51) were each reviewed and found to be build artifacts, documentation artifacts, or documented references; they are excluded.

summary.zh: 行为分析未发现安装钩子、混淆载荷、凭据文件直接读取或异常外联；唯一外联为 DeepSeek 官方余额接口。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis found no install hooks, obfuscated payloads, direct credential file reading, or anomalous outbound connections. The only outbound connection is DeepSeek's official balance endpoint.

summary.zh: 模型面与文本面审查通过：无工具描述、无系统提示注入、无指令类文件、无诱导措辞。
summary.en: Model and text surface review passed: no tool descriptions, no system prompt injection, no instruction-type files, and no inducing wording.

summary.zh: 未做动态验证：本环境未提供动态沙箱产物。
summary.en: No dynamic verification was performed: this environment did not provide dynamic sandbox artifacts.

limits.zh:
首次审计（full 模式），无基线版本可比较；能力声明取自代码实测（manifest 未显式声明能力块），已在报告中按实测推断。

任务卡 static-scan 预扫 4 条机械命中已逐条裁决：DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）三条——docs/cache-breakdown-preview.html:10 为独立预览页压缩样式、lib/client.js.map:1 为构建生成的 source map、README.md:8 为徽章图片内嵌的 base64 图标，均为构建或文档产物、无混淆执行行为，排除；DSH-C01（DG-R1-51）@ README.md:98 仅为文档说明凭据存放位置，代码实际经 dsh 凭据服务解析密钥、无直接读取文件路径，排除。

动态沙箱（L4）未执行：本环境未提供动态验证产物，运行时行为以静态分析为准；作者账号无市场侧验证信息，身份核验以仓库元数据为准。
limits.en:
First audit (full mode), no baseline version to compare. Capability declarations are inferred from actual code measurements (the manifest does not explicitly declare a capability block) and are inferred accordingly in this report.

The 4 mechanical hits from the static-scan task card pre-scan have been adjudicated one by one: DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) three hits—docs/cache-breakdown-preview.html:10 is a standalone preview page with compressed styles, lib/client.js.map:1 is a build-generated source map, README.md:8 is a base64 icon embedded in a badge image; all are build or documentation artifacts with no obfuscated execution behavior, so they are excluded. DSH-C01 (DG-R1-51) at README.md:98 is merely documentation explaining where credentials are stored; the code actually resolves the key via the dsh credential service and has no direct file-reading path, so it is excluded.

Dynamic sandbox (L4) was not executed: this environment did not provide dynamic verification artifacts, so runtime behavior is based on static analysis. The author account has no marketplace-side verification information; identity verification is based on repository metadata.
